invariants.rule: A persisted Objective contains at least one Task; an empty unaccepted UI draft is not a persisted Objective.
A Task belongs to at most one Objective and may remain unscheduled.
Objective membership requires a complete valid accepted Task interval; timestamps are never invented or rounded to create eligibility.
WFM source plan, accepted Task plan, Objective envelope and actual execution are distinct authorities.
Accepted Objectives never overlap; global strict positive-duration Task overlap is transitive.
Customer, RFC hierarchy and work-package context never partition temporal overlap authority.
Exact interval touch is non-overlap unless separately reviewed into one Objective.
Objective start does not start member Tasks.
Each Task owns independent execution chronology and reviewed outcome.
Whole-Objective Cancelled is valid only when no member Task began execution.
Review acceptance time never substitutes for execution start/end/effective cancellation time.
Objective/Task success never by itself proves spare use, Device work or Inventory physical consequence.
Correction preserves the same attempt identity; retry always creates a new Task attempt identity.
Distinct canonical WFM Task Nos remain distinct attempts even under the same RFC.
Competing WFM restriction applies only to overlapping active attempts of the same reviewed activity lineage.
Plan/membership locks arise from accepted execution/history/explicit locks, never merely from clock passage.
In-Progress loss of all executable work yields Incomplete — Awaiting Review, never automatic Completed or Cancelled.
Accepted execution/history permanently blocks hard deletion of the affected Objective/Task.
Historical provider completion may support structure only; it cannot fabricate execution/outcome/Inventory evidence.
Objective scheduling timezone affects schedule input/presentation only and never rewrites canonical UTC or source chronology.
